n_angles.description: Number of evenly spaced angles from 0 to 90 degrees (91 = 1-degree steps).
n_angles.title: N Angles

parameters.description: Projectile settings. launch_angle_deg is ignored: the sweep varies it.

best_angle_deg.description: Angle maximising the range, refined by a bounded Brent search (~1e-6 deg).
best_angle_deg.title: Best Angle Deg

vacuum_best_angle_deg.description: Closed-form best angle with no drag: tan(theta) = v0 / sqrt(v0^2 + 2 g h).
vacuum_best_angle_deg.title: Vacuum Best Angle Deg

vacuum_best_range.description: m, closed form with no drag
vacuum_best_range.title: Vacuum Best Range

Assumption.description: A modelling assumption, stated so a reader can judge when the model stops applying.
Assumption.title: Assumption

missing_markers_found.description: How often each missing-value representation occurred; '' = empty cell.
missing_markers_found.title: Missing Markers Found

max_energy_balance_residual.description: max |KE + PE + W_drag - E0| / E0 over step nodes. Exactly 0 for the true solution, so this measures numerical error (the landing node also carries interpolation error).
max_energy_balance_residual.title: Max Energy Balance Residual

max_position_error.description: Max Euclidean distance (m) between numerical and exact positions over the solver's accepted step nodes. The last node, the landing, is located by interpolating the solver's dense output, so it also carries interpolation error.
max_position_error.title: Max Position Error

effective_depreciation.description: lambda = n + g + n g + delta, per year.
effective_depreciation.title: Effective Depreciation

half_life_years.description: ln 0.5 / ln rho. A linearisation: valid only close to the steady state.
half_life_years.title: Half Life Years

rho.description: Local convergence factor f'(k*) per year (0 < rho < 1).
rho.title: Rho

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact bytes: an identity, not a quality check.
sha256.title: Sha256

content_base64.description: The same file the run profiled, base64-encoded. Checked by SHA-256 and size before it is read; it is used for this replay only and never stored.
content_base64.title: Content Base64

duplicate_rows.description: Rows identical, character for character, to an earlier row. Not removed.
duplicate_rows.title: Duplicate Rows

original.description: None if the original run did not record it.
original.title: Original

relative.description: |numerical - analytical| / |analytical|; null when the reference is 0.
relative.title: Relative

row.description: 1-based data row; the header is not counted.
row.title: Row

field.description: Summary field, nested names joined by dots.
field.title: Field

h.description: Effective step T/N, s. Convergence is fitted against this.
h.title: H

kh.description: Step size in units of the drag time 1/k (dimensionless).
kh.title: Kh

max_position_error.description: m; null if the run diverged
max_position_error.title: Max Position Error

max_velocity_error.description: m/s; null if the run diverged
max_velocity_error.title: Max Velocity Error

dt_values.description: Requested time steps (s). Each run uses h = T/N with N = ceil(T/dt), so that every run ends exactly at the horizon T.
dt_values.title: Dt Values

horizon.description: Exact flight time T (s); every run covers [0, T].
horizon.title: Horizon

position_scale.description: max |r| of the exact solution, m
position_scale.title: Position Scale

velocity_scale.description: max |v| of the exact solution, m/s
velocity_scale.title: Velocity Scale

KindCounts.description: How the non-missing cells were classified, before any override.
KindCounts.title: KindCounts

LoggedRun.description: A stored run as the log shows it: the record plus its lab and a one-line headline.

headline.description: One line written by the model; '—' if unavailable.
headline.title: Headline

inputs.description: Validated inputs exactly as used by the run.
inputs.title: Inputs

lab.description: The lab, from the model id: physics, economy or quant.
lab.title: Lab

name.description: User label; not part of the results.
name.title: Name

note.description: User note; not part of the results.
note.title: Note

output_digest.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the full response without its run metadata. Equal digests mean every output value is bit-identical. None for v1.
output_digest.title: Output Digest

replay_needs_file.description: True if replaying needs the user to supply a file again (an upload).
replay_needs_file.title: Replay Needs File

replay_of.description: run_id of the run this record replayed, if it is a replay.
replay_of.title: Replay Of

summary.description: Headline metrics; series are not stored.
summary.title: Summary

LoggedRun.title: LoggedRun

fit_note.description: Why no order was fitted, if none was.
fit_note.title: Fit Note

runs.description: Ordered from coarsest to finest step.
runs.title: Runs

stability_limit_kh.description: Largest kh for which |R(-kh)| <= 1; null if stable for every kh.
stability_limit_kh.title: Stability Limit Kh

trajectory.description: Coarsest linearly stable, non-divergent run, for plotting.

ModelInfo.description: Identifies exactly which model (and which version of its equations) produced a result.

version.description: Semantic version of the model's equations and outputs.
version.title: Version

ModelInfo.title: ModelInfo

std.description: Sample standard deviation (n - 1); None if n < 2 or not representable.
std.title: Std

order.description: Least-squares slope of log10(error) against log10(h).
order.title: Order

column_types.description: Type overrides; columns not listed keep their inferred type.
column_types.title: Column Types

missing_markers.description: Cell values (after trimming spaces, case-sensitive) read as missing, in addition to empty cells, which are always missing.
missing_markers.title: Missing Markers

save_experiment.description: Opt in to logging this run. Only the file's hash and size, the options (including any missing-value markers typed) and a few counts are stored: no rows, file name or column names.
save_experiment.title: Save Experiment

drag_coefficient.description: Linear drag coefficient b in kg/s (drag force F = -b v). 0 means vacuum.
drag_coefficient.title: Drag Coefficient

gravity.description: Gravitational acceleration in m/s^2 (default: standard gravity).
gravity.title: Gravity

launch_angle_deg.description: Launch angle above the horizontal, in degrees.
launch_angle_deg.title: Launch Angle Deg

launch_height.description: Height of the launch point above the ground, in m.
launch_height.title: Launch Height

n_samples.description: Number of points in the resampled series.
n_samples.title: N Samples

save_experiment.description: Record inputs and summary metrics in the experiment log.
save_experiment.title: Save Experiment

ProjectileSeries.description:
Uniformly resampled series for plotting. Numerical values come from the solver's
dense-output interpolant; analytical values from the exact solution at the same times.
ProjectileSeries.title: ProjectileSeries

ReferenceLine.description:
A line of the *theoretical* slope through the finest point in the fit range.
It is a visual guide, not a fit.
ReferenceLine.title: ReferenceLine

dataset.description: Only for a dataset profile of an uploaded file.

save_experiment.description: Store the replay as a new record linked to the original (replay_of). The original record is never changed.
save_experiment.title: Save Experiment

basis.description: output_digest: the digests were compared (every output value). summary: the digests differ, so the stored summary was compared with tolerances; outputs not in the summary (such as time series) are not compared. summary_only: a v1 record with no digest, so only its summary could be compared.
basis.title: Basis

largest_difference.description: The field furthest from agreement, relative to its tolerance; None if every field is exactly equal.

RunLabels.description:
A run's name and note. Omitted fields are kept; null or "" clears. Nothing else about
a run can be changed: its inputs, results and fingerprints are the scientific record.
RunLabels.title: RunLabels

RunMetadata.description: Everything needed to reproduce (or audit) a single run.

cpu.description: Processor model; another CPU can change the last bits.
cpu.title: Cpu

elapsed_ms.description: Wall-clock compute time. Not reproducible by nature.
elapsed_ms.title: Elapsed Ms

git_commit.description: Commit of the code that ran ('-dirty' if the checkout had changes; 'unknown' if it could not be determined).
git_commit.title: Git Commit

input_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the validated inputs. Identical inputs produce identical hashes, so repeated runs can be grouped and compared.
input_hash.title: Input Hash

output_digest.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of this response without its metadata (keys sorted, no whitespace). Equal digests mean bit-identical outputs; anyone can recompute it from the response.
output_digest.title: Output Digest

RunMetadata.title: RunMetadata

new_savings_rate.description: Savings rate s1 from the policy year onwards. Equal to s0 means no change.
new_savings_rate.title: New Savings Rate

policy_year.description: First year t whose output is saved at s1. It first changes capital in year t + 1. Must be below horizon_years.
policy_year.title: Policy Year

capital_share.description: Capital share alpha in Y = K^alpha (A L)^(1 - alpha). Dimensionless.
capital_share.title: Capital Share

depreciation.description: Depreciation rate delta, fraction per year.
depreciation.title: Depreciation

initial_capital_ratio.description: Initial capital per effective worker as a multiple of the baseline steady state k*(s0). 1 starts at the steady state.
initial_capital_ratio.title: Initial Capital Ratio

population_growth.description: Labour growth rate n, fraction per year.
population_growth.title: Population Growth

savings_rate.description: Savings rate s0 before the policy change: share of output invested.
savings_rate.title: Savings Rate

technology_growth.description: Technology growth rate g, fraction per year.
technology_growth.title: Technology Growth

SolowPathResponse.description: One scenario, t = 0..H. Per effective worker unless stated.

output_per_worker_growth.description: G_t = (Y/L)_{t+1} / (Y/L)_t - 1 for t = 0..H-1, fraction per year.
output_per_worker_growth.title: Output Per Worker Growth

output_per_worker_index.description: Output per actual worker, Y/L, as an index with year 0 = 100.
output_per_worker_index.title: Output Per Worker Index

SolowPathResponse.title: SolowPathResponse

method.description: SciPy solve_ivp method. RK45: Dormand-Prince 5(4). DOP853: 8th-order Dormand-Prince. Radau: implicit, for stiff problems (very strong drag).
method.title: Method

Tolerance.description:
Two values agree if ``|a - b| <= absolute + relative * max(|a|, |b|)``. Both zero means
exact equality, which is also how non-numbers (counts, names, None) are compared.
Tolerance.title: Tolerance

h.description: Step size of the plotted run, s
h.title: H

content_base64.description: The file's bytes, base64-encoded (2 MiB of file at most). The file name is not sent: the server does not need it.
content_base64.title: Content Base64

ValidationCheck.description: A diagnostic of this run. Proofs and grid evidence live in the tests and docs.

threshold.description: Pass if value <= threshold; None = info only.
threshold.title: Threshold

ValidationCheck.title: ValidationCheck

info.description: Validated scientific simulations with explicit assumptions and units.
info.title: SimForge API

schema.title: Response List Experiments Api V1 Experiments Get

post.description:
Rerun a stored run with the same inputs and the same model version, and say whether
the same answer came back: identical, within tolerance, or differs.

schema.title: Response List Samples Api V1 Quant Datasets Samples Get
